summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Fixed Stars
summary.text: Continuation of a Florentine codex catalogue listing astrological questions on afflicted eyes, love, ingresses, war, aphetas, illness, legitimacy, benefic and malefic influences, and the nature of the stars. It cites Māshā'allāh’s radiation method, Euclid’s geometry, Ophiuchus, the dodecatemorion table, comets, Jupiter–Saturn conjunctions, and fixed stars.
